{{Top|leg}}
'''Double noon''' occurred on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that orbited two [[Star/Legends|stars]]. This was known on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]] were at their highest average point in the sky. The temperatures at this time were also at their highest.
